svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Block 20 x 22 x 6 mm, printed flat in ASA, 100 % infill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Through it: an 11 mm light hole on its centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Underneath: a 16.5 mm recess 1.5 mm deep for the window disc.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On top: a 13.5 x 18.5 mm pocket 2 mm deep for the ToF breakout,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with two 1.8 mm holes for M2 screws at the breakout's holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window: a 16 mm disc of 1.5 mm clear PMMA or glass, cut with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hole saw or bought; keep its film on until fitting.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: window in the recess with a thin ring of neutral-cure silicone

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on its face; holder centred over the 11 mm cover hole and bonded

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the floor with plastics epoxy. Breakout in the pocket, sensor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down onto the window, held by two M2 screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: looking in from outside, the sensor is centred in the hole.
